instruction: A brass tabletop orrery clock with a central pierced sun gear surrounded by three curved armatures carrying small planet spheres on riveted rods. Copper piping loops behind an exposed escapement of toothed cogs, and a pressure gauge with a cracked glass face sits at the base beside a tiny riveted boiler. Patina greens streak the brass between polished contact edges.
